invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破91（基于ATR上移止损），或融资费率Z-score升至100%以上（轧多风险加剧）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 91 (stop-loss moved up based on ATR), or funding Z-score rises above 100% (long squeeze risk intensifies).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破72000（基于日线支撑和ATR），或融资费率Z-score回落至150%以下（风险缓解）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 72000 (based on daily support and ATR), or funding Z-score falls below 150% (risk eases).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破0.098（基于ATR和支撑），或融资费率Z-score升至100%以上（轧多风险增加），或Qlib评分大幅下降。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 0.098 (based on ATR and support), or funding Z-score rises above 100% (long squeeze risk increases), or Qlib score drops significantly.
